title: Into the Wild Frontier
description:
S03 E07 — George Croghan: Frontier Peacemaker
When Chief Pontiac organizes a coalition of Native American tribes to attack British forts, frontier trader George Croghan risks his life on a perilous journey into the wilderness to find Pontiac, negotiate a peace agreement and prevent war.

title: The Cowboy Way: Alabama
description:
S02 E01 — Bubba, Cody and Booger: Back in the Saddle
Bubba, Booger and Cody undertake a huge cattle drive in Mississippi; Bubba and Kaley make a bet; Misty suffers an accident while trying to help Cody on the farm; Booger considers proposing to his girlfriend, Jaclyn.

title: Wild West Chronicles
description:
S05 E01 — James Masterson and the Battle of Cimarron
Deputy James Masterson and a group of lawmen from Ingalls, Kansas, attempt to seize the official county seal from the nearby town of Cimarron; their raid turns deadly when a mob of angry townspeople opens fire to defend the Cimarron courthouse.

title: Wild West Chronicles
description:
S05 E08 — Frank Hamer's First Gunfight
Soon after ranch hand Frank Hamer joins the Texas Rangers, he helps them hunt down a mysterious killer, takes part in his first gunfight, and demonstrates a natural gift for detective work that launches a legendary career in law enforcement.

title: Into the Wild Frontier
description:
S03 E05 — James Harrod: Kentucky's Founding Father
When frontiersman James Harrod founds Harrod's Town on Native American hunting grounds in Kentucky, he soon finds his new settlement under attack; his leadership is tested as he defends the first European settlement west of the Appalachian Mountains.

title: Wild West Chronicles
description:
S05 E05 — Marshal Garfias Faces the Mob
As a deputy in Phoenix, Enrique Garfias witnesses the lynching of prisoners by vigilantes; when he is later elected as the town's first marshal, he has a chance at redemption when he attempts to defend a gang of criminals from yet another angry mob.

title: Wild West Chronicles
description:
S05 E03 — Jesse James' Final Raid
Famous outlaw Jesse James convinces the James-Younger Gang to attempt its riskiest heist yet, a daring bank robbery in Northfield, Minnesota; their well-laid plans are thwarted by sharp-eyed citizens intent on protecting their hard-earned money.

description:
